title: Adaptive quant onboarding safety-bench and pinned-artifact fingerprinting
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build an adaptive onboarding pipeline that produces pinned quant artifacts (INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ) with deterministic artifact fingerprints, runs a safety/perf bench against a golden prompt corpus, and publishes regression telemetry + automated rollback thresholds. This ticket covers the orchestration glue, artifact metadata schema, and the initial canary ruleset used by runtime routing to prefer pinned safe variants.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline produces a quant artifact bundle with a stable fingerprint (hash + metadata) for INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ variants
Automated safety bench runs end-to-end and emits latency, p50/p95, token-perf, and quality delta against golden prompt set
Canary rule outputs a single pass/fail signal and a delta vector that higher-level routing can use to decide fallback
Artifacts and bench results are published to the model catalog UI with links to the artifact blob, calibration logs, and synthetic microbench traces
Regression thresholds are documented and actionable: quality drop > 1.5% on critical prompt set or p95 latency increase > 30% triggers hold-and-rollback recommendation
steps: Design artifact metadata schema: model_base, quant_type, bits, shard_layout, calibration_seed, runtime_variant_tag, fingerprint
Implement calibration worker that emits: calibration_stats.json, per-shard calibration seeds, and a KV-cache fingerprint snapshot
Wire a bench job that runs parallel quality checks: BLEU/ROUGE-like metric for structured outputs plus embedding-similarity pass/fail for semantic drift
Add latency microbench harness using representative input length distribution (50/200/1024 tokens) and report p50/p95/p99
Produce a composite canary score and a JSON delta vector; publish to model-catalog and to telemetry ingestion (metrics + traces)
Create a simple policy engine that maps composite score -> action (promote pin / hold / require manual triage)
Expose the artifact fingerprint and canary score in the Console (artifact detail + links to calibration logs and failing prompts)
Run a staged rollout: local dev -> infra staging -> dedicated canary pool -> broad rollout with automatic rollback on regression
metrics: quality_delta_pct: percent change vs baseline on golden prompt set
inference_token_cost_delta: percent cost change vs baseline
failed_prompt_count: number of golden prompts that cross semantic-similarity threshold
risks: Calibration nondeterminism across different GPU architectures could yield inconsistent fingerprints
Golden prompt set may not capture long-tail customer prompts — risk of false negatives
Running full benches for large models is expensive and may slow onboarding cadence
Automated rollback thresholds might be too strict/lenient without initial tuning leading to oscillation
comments: 2025-02-24 - Asha Patel: Kickoff meeting notes added. Agreed to baseline on A100 and H100 to detect architecture drift. Owner: Miguel Rivera. Next: draft schema and bench plan by 2025-02-28.

2025-02-28 - Miguel Rivera: Submitted initial artifact metadata schema in the repo. Chose fingerprint format: sha256 over weight-tar + deterministic metadata JSON. Open question: include kernel selection table in fingerprint? (trade-off: more reproducible vs larger fingerprint).

2025-03-03 - Lydia Chen (ML Infra): Ran end-to-end calibration on AWQ GPTQ on A100 and H100. Observed nontrivial kv-cache fingerprint differences due to allocator nondeterminism. Proposal: snapshot only logical KV content and model weight digests, not low-level allocator state.
2025-03-04 - Security review note (S. O'Neill): flagged that artifact bundles must be signed before publishing to catalog. Added requirement to attachments and release checklist.

2025-03-05 - PM review (Rohit Sharma): Set initial regression thresholds: quality_delta_pct > 1.5% OR p95_latency_ms increase > 30% -> fail. PM requests a follow-up to evaluate thresholds after 10 canaries.

2025-03-06 - Miguel Rivera: Implemented bench harness prototype. Bench runs on 3 model sizes (small/medium/large) and emits composite score. Next PR will add publishing to model-catalog UI and create a telemetry metric mapping for DataDog ingestion.
Future follow-up: add a manual review flow when composite score is marginal (score between 65 and 80) and add automatic rebaseline option if upstream base model legitimately changed.
